title: Company settings
subtitle: Business identity and default invoicing parameters
readOnlyHint: You can view these settings; only owners and managers can edit them.

form.logoUrlHint: Optional https link to your logo
form.remindersHint: The daily job sends reminders at 08:00 in the configured time zone, within business hours.
form.recordatorioDiasGraciaHint: Days after due date before an invoice counts as overdue (0–365).
form.recordatorioHoraFinHint: The job does not send reminders outside this range in tenant local time.

errors.puntoVentaInvalid: Point of sale must be between 1 and 9999
errors.reminderWindowInvalid: End hour must be after start hour

fiscalProviders.title: Fiscal e-invoicing (multi-organism)
fiscalProviders.subtitle: ARCA (Argentina) is the only provider with a working integration today; DGI (Uruguay) and SAT (Mexico) are capability-only stubs, with no live issuance.

paymentProviders.title: Payments (multi-provider)
paymentProviders.subtitle: Mercado Pago is the only live provider today; Payway and Stripe are capability-only stubs until a live adapter is implemented.

arca.title: ARCA electronic invoicing (CAE)
arca.subtitle: Homologación mock — credentials encrypted at rest; certificate and key are never shown after save.
arca.notConfigured: ARCA credentials are not configured yet.
arca.readOnlyHint: You can view status; only roles with fiscal settings permission can edit.
arca.certificatePlaceholderUpdate: Leave blank to keep current certificate; paste PEM to replace.
arca.privateKeyPlaceholderUpdate: Leave blank to keep current key; paste PEM to replace.

mercadopago.title: MercadoPago
mercadopago.subtitle: Optional integration — access token and webhook secret are encrypted and never shown after save.
mercadopago.readOnlyHint: You can view status; only roles with company settings permission can edit.
mercadopago.accessTokenPlaceholder: Paste your Mercado Pago access token…
mercadopago.accessTokenPlaceholderUpdate: Leave blank to keep current token; paste a new token to replace.
mercadopago.webhookSecretPlaceholderUpdate: Leave blank to keep current secret; paste a new value to replace.

meli.title: Mercado Libre
meli.subtitle: Connect the tenant seller account via OAuth. Tokens are encrypted and never displayed.
meli.readOnlyHint: You can view status; only roles with company settings permission can connect or disconnect.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load Mercado Libre status
errors.connectFailed: Could not start Mercado Libre connection

tiendanube.title: Tiendanube
tiendanube.subtitle: Connect the tenant store via OAuth. The access token is encrypted and never displayed.
tiendanube.readOnlyHint: You can view status; only roles with company settings permission can connect or disconnect.

woocommerce.title: WooCommerce
woocommerce.subtitle: Connect the store with a REST API consumer key/secret (Basic Auth). Credentials are encrypted and never displayed.
woocommerce.readOnlyHint: You can view status; only roles with company settings permission can connect or disconnect.
woocommerce.webhookUrl: Webhook URL (configure it in WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → Webhooks)
woocommerce.webhookSecretWarning: No webhook secret is set; incoming order webhooks will be rejected.

fields.webhookSecretHint: Must match the secret configured for the webhook in WooCommerce.

ecommerce.title: eCommerce integrations
ecommerce.subtitle: Connector status and shared sync log (catalog, stock and orders).

errors.loadFailed: Could not load the eCommerce sync log

printDevices.title: Print devices
printDevices.subtitle: Optional per customer: enable only if you use POS hardware. PDF and electronic invoicing work without any printer.
printDevices.optInHint: No POS printers are enabled. Set FISCAL_PRINTER_ENABLED and/or THERMAL_PRINTER_ENABLED on the server when this business uses them.

feedback.fiscalFallback: Fiscal disabled: system would use legal PDF.
feedback.thermalFallback: Thermal disabled: system would use legal PDF.

proveedorAlertas.title: Payable invoice alerts
proveedorAlertas.hint: Daily job at 07:00 (company timezone). In-app notifications go to owner and manager.
proveedorAlertas.diasPrevio: Days before due date to warn
proveedorAlertas.emailNote: External email requires server SMTP; without a configured recipient only in-app applies.

retenciones.title: Withholdings and perceptions
retenciones.hint: Tenant-configurable regimes. Automatic calculation on payments and invoices will ship in #229. Customer/supplier VAT condition uses the existing master (AFIP registry #192 pending).
retenciones.readOnlyHint: Read-only; only roles with fiscal permission can edit.
